metaDesc: A production-ready IndieStack for independent developers

hero.title: Build your SaaS faster
hero.subtitle: Integrates Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase and more. Focus on your business logic.

featuresSection.title: Everything you need to ship
featuresSection.description: A complete stack for independent developers. Batteries included.

techStackSection.title: Modern tools, battle-tested
techStackSection.description: Each piece is chosen for productivity, scalability, and developer experience.

ctaSection.title: Ready to start building?
ctaSection.description: Get started in minutes. No credit card required.

features.title: Authentication & Auth
features.description: Email, OAuth (GitHub, Google), and social login. Session management, MFA, and RLS policies included.

features.title: PostgreSQL Database
features.description: Full Postgres via Supabase with real-time subscriptions, auto-generated APIs, and row-level security.

features.title: Team Management
features.description: Multi-tenant architecture with roles, invites, and granular permissions.

features.title: Real-time Updates
features.description: Supabase Realtime for live data sync across clients. No polling, no complexity.

features.title: Monitoring & Errors
features.description: Sentry integration for error tracking, performance monitoring, and crash reports.

features.title: Billing & Subscriptions
features.description: Stripe-ready subscription management with tiered pricing and payment history.
